name: fm
description: Lend existing tools to Apple's on-device model through program callbacks. Prepare context and authorized tool scope once. Codex uses scripts/fm_host.js with actual host callbacks. Claude uses scripts/fm_claude.py with claude mcp serve or selected MCP servers. Scripts feed results to FM without host LLM callback turns. Use fm:ask for setup and permissions.

interface.shortDescription: Lend host tools to FM through program callbacks
defaultPrompt: Use fm:ask. Prepare context and authorized tool scope once. Use scripts/fm_host.js with actual Codex tool callbacks, or scripts/fm_claude.py for Claude MCP tools. Let program code handle every callback and return the completed result. Verify the final answer.
